verdict.rationale: Bulk registry extracts are a fair ask for a state business-registry service, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack shows no bulk dataset or extract offering. Registry data is reached only through account-based, pay-per-search SOSPortal queries at $1.00 per search, plus per-document copy orders. The freely downloadable material consists of blank filing forms and instructions, not public datasets, so it does not count toward this story.
